author: raymond91125
body:
[Written by Claude]

* **InterPro ID / label**
IPR004803 tRNA-guanine transglycosylase (family; members PANTHER PTHR46499, HAMAP MF_00168, NCBIfam TIGR00430)

* **Example sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
- P0A847 tgt, Queuine tRNA-ribosyltransferase (*Escherichia coli* K-12): bacterial, inserts preQ1
- O58843 tgtA, tRNA-guanine(15) transglycosylase (*Pyrococcus horikoshii*): archaeal G15 enzyme (RHEA:43164; in the child entry IPR004804). It gets GO:0008479 (tRNA-guanosine(34) queuine transglycosylase activity) via InterPro2GO from IPR004803.
- Q9BXR0 QTRT1 (*Homo sapiens*): eukaryotic queuine enzyme, the only group the current mapping fits

* **Description of issue**
IPR004803 maps to GO:0008479 (tRNA-guanosine(34) queuine transglycosylase activity). That term now maps to EC 2.4.2.64 and RHEA:16633, queuine insertion by eukaryotic QTRT1. The family contains three different activities:

| Members | Count (reviewed) | Correct GO term |
|---|---|---|
| Bacteria | 15,724 (460) | GO:7770158 (tRNA-guanosine(34) preQ1 transglycosylase activity), new in geneontology/go-ontology#32883 |
| Archaea, mostly in the child entry IPR004804 | 1,224 (41) | GO:0043867 (tRNA-guanine(15) transglycosylase activity) |
| Eukaryota (QTRT1) | 3,224 (10) | GO:0008479 (tRNA-guanosine(34) queuine transglycosylase activity) |

As a result, every bacterial and archaeal member gets the eukaryotic queuine activity.

Requested change: replace the IPR004803 mapping to GO:0008479 (tRNA-guanosine(34) queuine transglycosylase activity) with GO:0016763 (pentosyltransferase activity). That term is a parent of all three activities, and the child entry IPR004804 already maps to it. Mappings to the specific activities would need entries that separate the bacterial and eukaryotic groups, if InterPro has or creates them.

GO:7770158 (tRNA-guanosine(34) preQ1 transglycosylase activity) was merged on 2026-11-10 and will be available from the next GO release.
title: InterPro2GO issue: IPR004803 maps to GO:0008479 but covers bacterial, archaeal and eukaryotic TGTs

author: raymond91125
source_title: EcoCyc annotation review: E. coli tgt (P0A847) GO:0008479 to GO:7770158 (preQ1 transglycosylase)

author: sarach06
body:
Hello,
Thank you very much for this. I have replaced the term in IPR004803 for the parent one and replaced it in the child entry IPR004804 with GO:0043867 as it is more specific. Hope this helps. I checked and unfortunately, there are no specific signatures representing the bacterial and eukaryotic members separately. Hope this helps.
Best regards,
Sara
